record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: Does H2 have a Herman ring?

evidence.quote: Question 17. — Does H2 have a Herman ring?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A complex Hénon map is an automorphism of $\mathbb{C}^2$ of the form
$$H_{a,c}(x,y) = (x^2 + c - a y,\; x), \qquad a \in \mathbb{C}^*,\; c \in \mathbb{C},$$
or, more generally, any finite composition of such maps; write $\mathcal{H}_2$ for the family of (moderately dissipative) quadratic complex Hénon maps. A Fatou component $U$ of a holomorphic dynamical system is called a Herman ring if it is biholomorphic to an annulus $A_r = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : 1 < |z| < r\}$ for some $r > 1$ and the dynamics on $U$, conjugated through this biholomorphism, is an irrational rotation $z \mapsto e^{2\pi i \theta} z$ of $A_r$ (so $U$ is periodic and the first return map to $U$ acts as such a rotation).

Question: does there exist a map $H \in \mathcal{H}_2$ that possesses a (periodic) Fatou component which is a Herman ring in the above sense?
artifact.category_tag: Complex Hénon maps and Fatou components
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether quadratic complex Hénon maps can possess a Herman ring is posed as an open problem in a recent collection of open problems on Hénon maps (2023/2024). No published resolution appears in the literature; the authors conjecture an affirmative answer but provide no proof, and no subsequent work establishing existence or nonexistence has been located.
